parameters.controller: Holds the records, columns, sort order, selection and current page.
parameters.cellBuilder: Builds a cell from its row and column.
parameters.widths: Sets each column’s width in terminal cells, keyed by column ID.
parameters.onActivate: Runs when the reader opens a row or node.

keyboardNote: TermPagination counts pages from one. This example converts its page number to the table controller’s zero-based index.
